title: Do Drug Consumption Rooms Reduce Drug-Related Hospitalizations? Evidence from Switzerland
abstract: arXiv:2609.27732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper estimates the causal effect of drug consumption room (DCR) openings on drug-related hospitalizations in Switzerland. I exploit the staggered introduction of DCRs across Swiss cities between 1998 and 2022, using individual-level hospital records and a difference-in-differences estimator. DCR openings reduce drug-related hospitalization rates by roughly 35\% within 5 km of a facility. The reduction is most pronounced for fatal outcomes, which fall by 35\% while narcotics poisoning hospitalizations rise by a comparable amount, consistent with DCRs converting potentially fatal overdoses into non-fatal hospitalizations. Mental and behavioral disorder hospitalizations decline by 32\% while estimates for Hepatitis and HIV are imprecise. The findings support the role of DCRs as an effective harm reduction strategy.

translated_title: 毒品消费室能减少与毒品相关的住院吗？来自瑞士的证据
translated_abstract: 本文估计了毒品消费室（DCR）的开设对瑞士毒品相关住院的因果效应。作者利用1998年至2022年间瑞士各城市分期引入毒品消费室这一特征，采用个体层面的住院记录和双重差分估计方法。研究发现，毒品消费室的开设使设施周边5公里范围内的毒品相关住院率降低了约35%。这一效应在致命结局上最为显著：致命结果下降了35%，而麻醉品中毒住院人数上升了相近的幅度，这与毒品消费室将潜在的致命药物过量转化为非致命住院的机制相一致。精神和行为障碍相关住院下降了32%，而关于肝炎和艾滋病的估计则不够精确。研究结果支持毒品消费室作为一种有效减害策略的作用。
tldr: 本文利用瑞士1998至2022年间各城市分期开设毒品消费室的准自然实验和双重差分方法，首次以个体住院数据证明毒品消费室使周边5公里内毒品相关住院率降低约35%，其机制主要是将潜在致命的药物过量转化为非致命的中毒住院，从而证实毒品消费室是一种有效的减害策略。
en_tdlr: Exploiting the staggered rollout of drug consumption rooms across Swiss cities (1998–2022) with individual-level hospital records and a difference-in-differences design, this paper shows that DCR openings reduce drug-related hospitalization rates by roughly 35% within 5 km, mainly by converting potentially fatal overdoses into non-fatal hospitalizations, supporting DCRs as an effective harm reduction strategy.
